ACTION: General status indicating that an action has been performed.
ADD_ACCOUNT_CREATOR: Indicates that an account creator has been added.
ADD_ACCOUNT_CREATOR_TRIGGER: Indicates that the process to add an account creator has been triggered.
ADMIN_ROLE_ADDED: Indicates that an admin role has been assigned.
ADMIN_ROLE_REMOVED: Indicates that an admin role has been removed.
APP_RESULT_TEST_FAILED: Indicates that an application result test has failed.
APP_RESULT_TEST_SUCCCESS: Indicates that an application result test has succeeded.
APP_TRANSACTION_TEST_FAILED: Indicates that an application transaction test has failed.
APP_TRANSACTION_TEST_SUCESS: Indicates that an application transaction test has succeeded.
CLEAR: Indicates that a clear action has been performed.
CONFIG_CHECK_FAILED: Indicates that a configuration check has failed.
CONFIG_CHECK_SUCCESS: Indicates that a configuration check has succeeded.
CREATE: Indicates that a create action has been performed.
CREATE_FAILED: Indicates that a create action has failed.
DELETE: Indicates that a delete action has been performed.
DELETE_FAILED: Indicates that a delete action has failed.
DOWNLOAD: Indicates that a download action has been performed.
DOWNLOAD_FAILED: Indicates that a download action has failed.
HARD_DELETE: Indicates that a hard delete action has been performed.
HARD_DELETE_TRIGGER: Indicates that the process to perform a hard delete has been triggered.
HOOK_FAILURE_NOTIFICATION: Indicates that a hook failure notification has been sent.
NOTIFICATION: Indicates that a notification has been sent.
NOTIFICATION_ERROR: Indicates that an error occurred while sending a notification. Click on the information icon to learn the exact cause of this error.
READ: Indicates that a read action has been performed.
READ_FAILED: Indicates that a read action has failed.
RESEND_INVITE: Indicates that an invite has been resent.
REVOKE_SOFT_DELETE: Indicates that a soft delete has been revoked.
ROTATE: Indicates that a rotation action has been performed.
SOFT_DELETE: Indicates that a soft delete action has been performed.
SOFT_DELETE_SUCCESS: Indicates that a soft delete action has succeeded.
TRIGGER: Indicates that a trigger action has been performed.
TRIGGER_DOWNLOAD: Indicates that a download has been triggered.
TRIGGER_ENROLLMENT_MAILL: Indicates that an enrollment mail has been triggered.
UPDATE: Indicates that an update action has been performed.
UPDATE_FAILED: Indicates that an update action has failed.
USER: Status related to a user action
WORKFLOW_ROLE: Indicates that a workflow role has been assigned.
WORKFLOW_TRIGGERED: Indicates that a workflow has been triggered.
